data.description: Project-local SQLite persistence for versioned reusable QA job definitions, links to design specifications and tasks, tags, immutable execution groups, and append-only per-job evidence. Job-definition versions protect overlapping edits; uniquely identified evidence appends do not serialize unrelated runs. Current state is derived from latest evidence plus staleness.
data.name: QA Store and Run Evidence
data.technology: SQLite, per-job versions, immutable run evidence
